rationale: Use the existing People role panel and repeat no form fields. Add role has a direct effect and preserves other roles and account status. The separate submit control names its replacement effect. Unauthorized humans have no Add role control. No agent action or new route.
verification: The role panel test exercises selection, preservation of the lifecycle form, held-role disabling and visibility, while server tests exercise current human authority, additive write, retry and audit failure. Served portal verification is separate from these tests.
